cohort.stoppage_bucket_policy: zero displayed delta is observed; incomplete-pass is inferred from PBP; penalty flag is observed but its clock effect is unresolved; timeout and out-of-bounds causes are unavailable in this PBP schema
cohort.target: current PBP game_seconds_remaining minus next non-null-play_type row in the same quarter; negative/missing/quarter-crossing intervals unresolved
cohort.target_label: inferred PBP inter-play delta; not whistle time or live-play duration
cohort.tracking_feature_cutoff: frames snap-3, snap-2, snap-1 only; 22 same players with 11 per side; SNAP and later coordinates never used

interpretation: Retrospective scoring of a frozen weeks 6-9 evaluation cohort; those weeks were previously examined, so this is not blind holdout validation.
limitations: Weeks 6-9 were examined in earlier E3 work; frozen scoring does not restore blind holdout status.
PBP target is an inter-play clock-stamp delta. It cannot separate live duration, between-play time, timeout, out-of-bounds, and other stoppages.
A uses the observed held-out PBP event family to select donor runoffs; only B and C are pre-snap state predictions.
The game-level cumulative gap aggregates only common tracked target rows and does not simulate missed plays, period transitions, game scores, or outcomes.
LP coverage marks 356 tracked plays unverified and reports 1,019 LP scrimmage plays without a BDB play; neither is treated as a valid tracked example.

game_level_cumulative_clock_gap.definition: sum predicted inter-play deltas minus sum observed PBP deltas over the same common tracked plays within each game; not a complete-game simulation

models.A_sampled_runoff: E1 event-and-state-conditioned sample of observed runoff donors; held-out event family is supplied from PBP, so this is retrospective and not a pre-snap prediction
models.B_pbp_presnap: PBP-only state-conditional median; no play_type, outcome, or future fields in predictors
models.C_tracking_presnap: B plus verified 2022 BDB all-22 pre-snap team aggregates from snap-3 through snap-1; no play outcome or future tracking fields

training.B_form: PBP-only pre-snap conditional median, exact pinned single-model backoff levels, minimum bucket 25
training.C_form: same PBP features plus binned offense/defense mean speed, acceleration and nearest-teammate spacing; same pinned tracking-model backoff levels, minimum bucket 25
training.C_training_population: only weeks 1-5 target rows with a complete all-22 pre-snap record and verified LP join
